resolution: Reported the verified post-slice architecture status. The framework command authority, correlated outcome envelopes, native event validation, floor control, piece placement, and correlated world undo/redo now form a proven end-to-end production path. Clarified that this proof currently covers four editor command identities only; the cart-local command table, dispatcher, context projections, most authored domains, native journals, and the schema-driven settings organ remain legacy or unmigrated. Recommended making the framework registry the sole projection source for the world surface and migrating the remaining world/build actions next before advancing through Map Paint, model authoring, library/project actions, and settings.
